verses.textZh: 耶稣基督的使徒彼得，写信给那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亚西亚、庇推尼寄居的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣基督的使徒彼得，写信给那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亚西亚、庇推尼寄居的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣基督的使徒彼得写信给那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亚细亚、庇推尼寄居的，
verses.textEnNiv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To God’s elect, exiles scattered throughout the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,
verses.textEnEsv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who are elect exiles of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the pilgrims of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. I am writing to God’s chosen people who are living as foreigners in the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
verses.textEnNasb: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who reside as strangers, scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, who are chosen
verses.textEn: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To God’s elect, exiles scattered throughout the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,

verses.textZh: 就是照着父神的预知蒙拣选，借着圣灵得成圣洁，因而顺服，并且被耶稣基督的血洒过的人。愿恩惠平安多多地加给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是照着父神的预知蒙拣选，借着圣灵得成圣洁，因而顺服，并且被耶稣基督的血洒过的人。愿恩惠平安多多地加给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是照父神的先见被拣选，藉着圣灵得成圣洁，以致顺服耶稣基督，又蒙他血所洒的人。愿恩惠、平安多多地加给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: who have been chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through the sanctifying work of the Spirit, to be obedient to Jesus Christ and sprinkled with his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
verses.textEnNlt: God the Father knew you and chose you long ago, and his Spirit has made you holy. As a result, you have obeyed him and have been cleansed by the blood of Jesus Christ. May God give you more and more grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, by the sanctifying work of the Spirit, to obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with His blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
verses.textEn: who have been chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through the sanctifying work of the Spirit, to be obedient to Jesus Christ and sprinkled with his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

verses.textZh: 我们主耶稣基督的父神是应当称颂的。他照着自己的大怜悯，借着耶稣基督从死人中复活，重生了我们，使我们有永活的盼望，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们主耶稣基督的父神是应当称颂的。他照着自己的大怜悯，借着耶稣基督从死人中复活，重生了我们，使我们有永活的盼望，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿颂赞归与我们主耶稣基督的父神！他曾照自己的大怜悯，藉耶稣基督从死里复活，重生了我们，叫我们有活泼的盼望，
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to His abundant mercy has begotten us again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.textEnNlt: All praise to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. It is by his great mercy that we have been born again, because God raised Jesus Christ from the dead. Now we live with great expectation,
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to His great mercy has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.textEn: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

verses.textZh: 可以得着不能朽坏、不能玷污、不能衰残，为你们存留在天上的基业，
verses.textZhCnvs: 可以得着不能朽坏、不能玷污、不能衰残，为你们存留在天上的基业，
verses.textZhCuv: 可以得着不能朽坏、不能玷污、不能衰残、为你们存留在天上的基业。
verses.textEnNiv: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you,
verses.textEnEsv: to an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,
verses.textEnNkjv: to an inheritance incorruptible and undefiled and that does not fade away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.textEnNlt: and we have a priceless inheritance—an inheritance that is kept in heaven for you, pure and undefiled, beyond the reach of change and decay.
verses.textEnNasb: to obtain an inheritance which is imperishable, undefiled, and will not fade away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.textEn: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you,

verses.textZh: 就是你们这因信蒙神能力保守的人，得着预备在末世要显现的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是你们这因信蒙神能力保守的人，得着预备在末世要显现的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这因信蒙神能力保守的人，必能得着所预备、到末世要显现的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: who through faith are shielded by God’s power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.textEnEsv: who by God’s power are being guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.textEnNkjv: who are kept by the power of God through faith for salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.textEnNlt: And through your faith, God is protecting you by his power until you receive this salvation, which is ready to be revealed on the last day for all to see.
verses.textEnNasb: who are protected by the power of God through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.textEn: who through faith are shielded by God’s power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们要喜乐。然而，你们现今在各种试炼中或许暂时会难过，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们要喜乐。然而，你们现今在各种试炼中或许暂时会难过，
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，你们是大有喜乐；但如今，在百般的试炼中暂时忧愁，
verses.textEnNiv: In all this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.
verses.textEnEsv: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,
verses.textEnNkjv: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved by various trials,
verses.textEnNlt: So be truly glad. There is wonderful joy ahead, even though you must endure many trials for a little while.
verses.textEnNasb: In this you greatly rejoice, even though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been distressed by various trials,
verses.textEn: In all this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.

verses.textZh: 是要叫你们的信心经过试验，就比那被火炼过，仍会朽坏的金子更宝贵，可以在耶稣基督显现的时候，得着称赞、荣耀和尊贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是要叫你们的信心经过试验，就比那被火炼过，仍会朽坏的金子更宝贵，可以在耶稣基督显现的时候，得着称赞、荣耀和尊贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫你们的信心既被试验，就比那被火试验仍然能坏的金子更显宝贵，可以在耶稣基督显现的时候得着称赞、荣耀、尊贵。
verses.textEnNiv: These have come so that the proven genuineness of your faith—of greater worth than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than gold that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the genuineness of your faith, being much more precious than gold that perishes, though it is tested by fire, may be found to praise, honor, and glory at the revelation of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: These trials will show that your faith is genuine. It is being tested as fire tests and purifies gold—though your faith is far more precious than mere gold. So when your faith remains strong through many trials, it will bring you much praise and glory and honor on the day when Jesus Christ is revealed to the whole world.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the proof of your faith, being more precious than gold which perishes though tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
verses.textEn: These have come so that the proven genuineness of your faith—of greater worth than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.

verses.textZh: 你们虽然没有见过他，却爱他；现在虽然不能看见他，却信他。因此，你们就有无法形容、满有荣耀的大喜乐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们虽然没有见过他，却爱他；现在虽然不能看见他，却信他。因此，你们就有无法形容、满有荣耀的大喜乐，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们虽然没有见过他，却是爱他；如今虽不得看见，却因信他就有说不出来、满有荣光的大喜乐；
verses.textEnNiv: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
verses.textEnEsv: Though you have not seen him, you love him. Though you do not now see him, you believe in him and rejoice with joy that is inexpressible and filled with glory,
verses.textEnNkjv: whom having not seen you love. Though now you do not see Him, yet believing, you rejoice with joy inexpressible and full of glory,
verses.textEnNlt: You love him even though you have never seen him. Though you do not see him now, you trust him; and you rejoice with a glorious, inexpressible joy.
verses.textEnNasb: and though you have not seen Him, you love Him, and though you do not see Him now, but believe in Him, you greatly rejoice with joy inexpressible and full of glory,
verses.textEn: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

verses.textZh: 得到你们信心的效果，就是灵魂得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得到你们信心的效果，就是灵魂得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且得着你们信心的果效，就是灵魂的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: for you are receiving the end result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
verses.textEnEsv: obtaining the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: receiving the end of your faith—the salvation of your souls.
verses.textEnNlt: The reward for trusting him will be the salvation of your souls.
verses.textEnNasb: obtaining as the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
verses.textEn: for you are receiving the end result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

verses.textZh: 论到这救恩，那预言你们要得恩典的众先知，都寻求考察过，
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到这救恩，那预言你们要得恩典的众先知，都寻求考察过，
verses.textZhCuv: 论到这救恩，那预先说你们要得恩典的众先知早已详细地寻求考察，
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied about the grace that was to be yours searched and inquired carefully,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of this salvation the prophets have inquired and searched carefully, who prophesied of the grace thatwouldcome to you,
verses.textEnNlt: This salvation was something even the prophets wanted to know more about when they prophesied about this gracious salvation prepared for you.
verses.textEnNasb: As to this salvation, the prophets who prophesied of the grace that would come to you made careful searches and inquiries,
verses.textEn: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,

verses.textZh: 就是把他们心里基督的灵所预先见证，关于基督要受苦难后来得荣耀，是在甚么时候和怎样的情况加以考察。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是把他们心里基督的灵所预先见证，关于基督要受苦难后来得荣耀，是在甚么时候和怎样的情况加以考察。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是考察在他们心里基督的灵，预先证明基督受苦难，后来得荣耀，是指着什么时候，并怎样的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: trying to find out the time and circumstances to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of the Messiah and the glories that would follow.
verses.textEnEsv: inquiring what person or time the Spirit of Christ in them was indicating when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the subsequent glories.
verses.textEnNkjv: searching what, or what manner of time, the Spirit of Christ who was in them was indicating when He testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow.
verses.textEnNlt: They wondered what time or situation the Spirit of Christ within them was talking about when he told them in advance about Christ’s suffering and his great glory afterward.
verses.textEnNasb: seeking to know what person or time the Spirit of Christ within them was indicating as He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
verses.textEn: trying to find out the time and circumstances to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of the Messiah and the glories that would follow.

verses.textZh: 他们蒙了启示，为这些事效力，并不是为自己，而是为你们。现在，借着传福音给你们的人，靠着从天上差来的圣灵，把这些事传给了你们；甚至天使也很想详细察看这些事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们蒙了启示，为这些事效力，并不是为自己，而是为你们。现在，借着传福音给你们的人，靠着从天上差来的圣灵，把这些事传给了你们；甚至天使也很想详细察看这些事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们得了启示，知道他们所传讲 的一切事，不是为自己，乃是为你们。那靠着从天上差来的圣灵传福音给你们的人，现在将这些事报给你们；天使也愿意详细察看这些事。
verses.textEnNiv: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you, when they spoke of the things that have now been told you by those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.
verses.textEnEsv: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you through those who preached the good news to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven, things into which angels long to look.
verses.textEnNkjv: To them it was revealed that, not to themselves, but to us they were ministering the things which now have been reported to you through those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things which angels desire to look into.
verses.textEnNlt: They were told that their messages were not for themselves, but for you. And now this Good News has been announced to you by those who preached in the power of the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. It is all so wonderful that even the angels are eagerly watching these things happen.
verses.textEnNasb: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, in these things which now have been announced to you through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look.
verses.textEn: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you, when they spoke of the things that have now been told you by those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.

verses.textZh: 所以要准备好你们的心，警醒谨慎，专心盼望耶稣基督显现的时候所要带给你们的恩典。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以要准备好你们的心，警醒谨慎，专心盼望耶稣基督显现的时候所要带给你们的恩典。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以要约束你们的心 ，谨慎自守，专心盼望耶稣基督显现的时候所带来给你们的恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, with minds that are alert and fully sober, set your hope on the grace to be brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed at his coming.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, preparing your minds for action, and being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and rest your hope fully upon the grace that is to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
verses.textEnNlt: So prepare your minds for action and exercise self-control. Put all your hope in the gracious salvation that will come to you when Jesus Christ is revealed to the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, prepare your minds for action, keep sober in spirit, set your hope completely on the grace to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Therefore, with minds that are alert and fully sober, set your hope on the grace to be brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed at his coming.

verses.textZh: 你们既是顺服的儿女，就不要再效法从前无知的时候放纵私欲的生活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既是顺服的儿女，就不要再效法从前无知的时候放纵私欲的生活。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既作顺命的儿女，就不要效法从前蒙昧无知的时候那放纵私欲的样子。
verses.textEnNiv: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.
verses.textEnEsv: As obedient children, do not be conformed to the passions of your former ignorance,
verses.textEnNkjv: as obedient children, not conforming yourselves to the former lusts, as in your ignorance;
verses.textEnNlt: So you must live as God’s obedient children. Don’t slip back into your old ways of living to satisfy your own desires. You didn’t know any better then.
verses.textEnNasb: As obedient children, do not be conformed to the former lusts which were yours in your ignorance,
verses.textEn: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.

verses.textZh: 那召你们的既是圣洁的，你们在一切所行的事上也要圣洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那召你们的既是圣洁的，你们在一切所行的事上也要圣洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 那召你们的既是圣洁，你们在一切所行的事上也要圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;
verses.textEnEsv: but as he who called you is holy, you also be holy in all your conduct,
verses.textEnNkjv: but as He who called you is holy, you also be holy in all your conduct,
verses.textEnNlt: But now you must be holy in everything you do, just as God who chose you is holy.
verses.textEnNasb: but like the Holy One who called you, be holy yourselves also in all your behavior;
verses.textEn: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;

verses.textZh: 因为圣经上记着说："你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为圣经上记着说："你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上记着说：「你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。」
verses.textEnNiv: for it is written: "Be holy, because I am holy."
verses.textEnEsv: since it is written, "You shall be holy, for I am holy."
verses.textEnNkjv: because it is written, "Be holy, for I am holy."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures say, "You must be holy because I am holy."
verses.textEnNasb: because it is written: "You shall be holy, for I am holy."
verses.textEn: for it is written: "Be holy, because I am holy."

verses.textZh: 你们既称那不偏待人、按各人行为审判的主为父，就当存敬畏的心，过你们寄居的日子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既称那不偏待人、按各人行为审判的主为父，就当存敬畏的心，过你们寄居的日子；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既称那不偏待人、按各人行为审判人的主为父，就当存敬畏的心度你们在世寄居的日子，
verses.textEnNiv: Since you call on a Father who judges each person’s work impartially, live out your time as foreigners here in reverent fear.
verses.textEnEsv: And if you call on him as Father who judges impartially according to each one’s deeds, conduct yourselves with fear throughout the time of your exile,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you call on the Father, who without partiality judges according to each one’s work, conduct yourselves throughout the time of your stay here in fear;
verses.textEnNlt: And remember that the heavenly Father to whom you pray has no favorites. He will judge or reward you according to what you do. So you must live in reverent fear of him during your time here as "temporary residents."
verses.textEnNasb: If you address as Father the One who impartially judges according to each one’s work, conduct yourselves in fear during the time of your stay on earth;
verses.textEn: Since you call on a Father who judges each person’s work impartially, live out your time as foreigners here in reverent fear.

verses.textZh: 因为知道你们得赎，脱去你们祖先传下的妄行，不是凭着能坏的金银等物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为知道你们得赎，脱去你们祖先传下的妄行，不是凭着能坏的金银等物，
verses.textZhCuv: 知道你们得赎，脱去你们祖宗所传流虚妄的行为，不是凭着能坏的金银等物，
verses.textEnNiv: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors,
verses.textEnEsv: knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, like silver or gold, from your aimless conduct received by tradition from your fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: For you know that God paid a ransom to save you from the empty life you inherited from your ancestors. And it was not paid with mere gold or silver, which lose their value.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that you were not redeemed with perishable things like silver or gold from your futile way of life inherited from your forefathers,
verses.textEn: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors,

verses.textZh: 而是凭着基督的宝血，就像无瑕疵无玷污的羊羔的血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而是凭着基督的宝血，就像无瑕疵无玷污的羊羔的血。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃是凭着基督的宝血，如同无瑕疵、无玷污的羔羊之血。
verses.textEnNiv: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.
verses.textEnEsv: but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot.
verses.textEnNkjv: but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot.
verses.textEnNlt: It was the precious blood of Christ, the sinless, spotless Lamb of God.
verses.textEnNasb: but with precious blood, as of a lamb unblemished and spotless, the blood of Christ.
verses.textEn: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

verses.textZh: 基督是在创立世界以前，是神所预知的，却在这末后的世代才为你们显现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督是在创立世界以前，是神所预知的，却在这末后的世代才为你们显现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督在创世以前是预先被神知道的，却在这末世才为你们显现。
verses.textEnNiv: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.
verses.textEnEsv: He was foreknown before the foundation of the world but was made manifest in the last times for the sake of you
verses.textEnNkjv: He indeed was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you
verses.textEnNlt: God chose him as your ransom long before the world began, but now in these last days he has been revealed for your sake.
verses.textEnNasb: For He was foreknown before the foundation of the world, but has appeared in these last times for the sake of you
verses.textEn: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.

verses.textZh: 借着他，你们信那使他从死人中复活、又给他荣耀的神，叫你们的信心和盼望都在于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着他，你们信那使他从死人中复活、又给他荣耀的神，叫你们的信心和盼望都在于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也因着他，信那叫他从死里复活、又给他荣耀的神，叫你们的信心和盼望都在于神。
verses.textEnNiv: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.
verses.textEnEsv: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
verses.textEnNkjv: who through Him believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
verses.textEnNlt: Through Christ you have come to trust in God. And you have placed your faith and hope in God because he raised Christ from the dead and gave him great glory.
verses.textEnNasb: who through Him are believers in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
verses.textEn: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.

verses.textZh: 你们既因顺从真理，洁净了自己的心灵，以致能真诚地爱弟兄，就应当从清洁的心里彼此切实相爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既因顺从真理，洁净了自己的心灵，以致能真诚地爱弟兄，就应当从清洁的心里彼此切实相爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既因顺从真理，洁净了自己的心，以致爱弟兄没有虚假，就当从心里 彼此切实相爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Now that you have purified yourselves by obeying the truth so that you have sincere love for each other, love one another deeply, from the heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Having purified your souls by your obedience to the truth for a sincere brotherly love, love one another earnestly from a pure heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: Since you have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit in sincere love of the brethren, love one another fervently with a pure heart,
verses.textEnNlt: You were cleansed from your sins when you obeyed the truth, so now you must show sincere love to each other as brothers and sisters. Love each other deeply with all your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Since you have purified your souls in obedience to the truth for a sincere love of the brothers and sisters, fervently love one another from the heart,
verses.textEn: Now that you have purified yourselves by obeying the truth so that you have sincere love for each other, love one another deeply, from the heart.

verses.textZh: 你们得了重生，并不是由于能坏的种子，却是由于不能朽坏的，就是借着神永活长存的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们得了重生，并不是由于能坏的种子，却是由于不能朽坏的，就是借着神永活长存的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们蒙了重生，不是由于能坏的种子，乃是由于不能坏的种子，是藉着神活泼常存的道。
verses.textEnNiv: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: since you have been born again, not of perishable seed but of imperishable, through the living and abiding word of God;
verses.textEnNkjv: having been born again, not of corruptible seed but incorruptible, through the word of God which lives and abides forever,
verses.textEnNlt: For you have been born again, but not to a life that will quickly end. Your new life will last forever because it comes from the eternal, living word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: for you have been born again not of seed which is perishable, but imperishable, that is, through the living and enduring word of God.
verses.textEn: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

verses.textZh: 因为 "所有的人 ，尽都如草， 他们的荣美，都像草上的花； 草必枯干，花必凋谢，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为 "所有的人 ，尽都如草， 他们的荣美，都像草上的花； 草必枯干，花必凋谢，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为 凡有血气的，尽都如草； 他的美荣都像草上的花。 草必枯干，花必凋谢；
verses.textEnNiv: For, "All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
verses.textEnEsv: for "All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flower of grass. The grass withers, and the flower falls,
verses.textEnNkjv: because "All flesh is as grass, And all the glory of man as the flower of the grass. The grass withers, And its flower falls away,
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "People are like grass; their beauty is like a flower in the field. The grass withers and the flower fades.
verses.textEnNasb: For, "All flesh is like grass, And all its glory is like the flower of grass. The grass withers, And the flower falls off,
verses.textEn: For, "All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

verses.textZh: 唯有主的道，永远长存。" 所传给你们的福音就是这道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有主的道，永远长存。" 所传给你们的福音就是这道。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有主的道是永存的。 所传给你们的福音就是这道。
verses.textEnNiv: but the word of the Lord endures forever." And this is the word that was preached to you.
verses.textEnEsv: but the word of the Lord remains forever." And this word is the good news that was preached to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the word of the Lord endures forever." Now this is the word which by the gospel was preached to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But the word of the Lord remains forever." And that word is the Good News that was preached to you.
verses.textEnNasb: But the word of the Lord endures forever." And this is the word which was preached to you.
verses.textEn: but the word of the Lord endures forever." And this is the word that was preached to you.

verses.textZh: 所以要除去一切恶毒、一切诡诈、虚伪、嫉妒和一切毁谤的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以要除去一切恶毒、一切诡诈、虚伪、嫉妒和一切毁谤的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们既除去一切的恶毒 、诡诈，并假善、嫉妒，和一切毁谤的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.
verses.textEnEsv: So put away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, laying aside all malice, all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and all evil speaking,
verses.textEnNlt: So get rid of all evil behavior. Be done with all deceit, hypocrisy, jealousy, and all unkind speech.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander,
verses.textEn: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.

verses.textZh: 像初生婴孩爱慕那纯净的灵奶，好叫你们靠它长大，进入救恩；
verses.textZhCnvs: 像初生婴孩爱慕那纯净的灵奶，好叫你们靠它长大，进入救恩；
verses.textZhCuv: 就要爱慕那纯净的灵奶，像才生的婴孩爱慕奶一样，叫你们因此渐长，以致得救。
verses.textEnNiv: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
verses.textEnEsv: Like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual milk, that by it you may grow up into salvation—
verses.textEnNkjv: as newborn babes, desire the pure milk of the word, that you may grow thereby,
verses.textEnNlt: Like newborn babies, you must crave pure spiritual milk so that you will grow into a full experience of salvation. Cry out for this nourishment,
verses.textEnNasb: and like newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the word, so that by it you may grow in respect to salvation,
verses.textEn: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,

verses.textZh: 因为你们已经体验过主是美善的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们已经体验过主是美善的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若尝过主恩的滋味，就必如此。
verses.textEnNiv: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
verses.textEnEsv: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.
verses.textEnNkjv: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
verses.textEnNlt: now that you have had a taste of the Lord’s kindness.
verses.textEnNasb: if you have tasted the kindness of the Lord.
verses.textEn: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

verses.textZh: 主是活石，虽然被人弃绝，却是神所拣选所珍贵的；你们到他面前来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 主是活石，虽然被人弃绝，却是神所拣选所珍贵的；你们到他面前来，
verses.textZhCuv: 主乃活石，固然是被人所弃的，却是被神所拣选、所宝贵的。
verses.textEnNiv: As you come to him, the living Stone—rejected by humans but chosen by God and precious to him—
verses.textEnEsv: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by men but in the sight of God chosen and precious,
verses.textEnNkjv: Coming to Him asto a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God and precious,
verses.textEnNlt: You are coming to Christ, who is the living cornerstone of God’s temple. He was rejected by people, but he was chosen by God for great honor.
verses.textEnNasb: And coming to Him as to a living stone which has been rejected by people, but is choice and precious in the sight of God,
verses.textEn: As you come to him, the living Stone—rejected by humans but chosen by God and precious to him—

verses.textZh: 也就像活石，被建造成为灵宫，作圣洁的祭司，借着耶稣基督献上蒙神悦纳的灵祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也就像活石，被建造成为灵宫，作圣洁的祭司，借着耶稣基督献上蒙神悦纳的灵祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们来到主面前，也就像活石，被建造成为灵宫，作圣洁的祭司，藉着耶稣基督奉献神所悦纳的灵祭。
verses.textEnNiv: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: you yourselves like living stones are being built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: you also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And you are living stones that God is building into his spiritual temple. What’s more, you are his holy priests. Through the mediation of Jesus Christ, you offer spiritual sacrifices that please God.
verses.textEnNasb: you also, as living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house for a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices that are acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 因为经上记着： "看哪，我在锡安放了一块石头， 就是所拣选所珍贵的房角石， 信靠他的人，必不致失望。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为经上记着： "看哪，我在锡安放了一块石头， 就是所拣选所珍贵的房角石， 信靠他的人，必不致失望。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上说： 看哪，我把所拣选、 所宝贵的房角石安放在锡安； 信靠他的人必不至于羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: For in Scripture it says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame."
verses.textEnEsv: For it stands in Scripture: "Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it is also contained in the Scripture, "Behold, I lay in Zion A chief cornerstone, elect, precious, And he who believes on Him will by no means be put to shame."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "I am placing a cornerstone in Jerusalem, chosen for great honor, and anyone who trusts in him will never be disgraced."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is contained in Scripture: "Behold, I am laying in Zion a choice stone, a precious cornerstone, And the one who believes in Him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEn: For in Scripture it says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

verses.textZh: 所以这石头，对你们信的人是宝贵的，但对那不信的人，却是 "建筑工人所弃的石头， 成了房角的主要石头。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以这石头，对你们信的人是宝贵的，但对那不信的人，却是 "建筑工人所弃的石头， 成了房角的主要石头。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他在你们信的人就为宝贵，在那不信的人有话说： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。
verses.textEnNiv: Now to you who believe, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, "The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,"
verses.textEnEsv: So the honor is for you who believe, but for those who do not believe, "The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, to you who believe, Heis precious; but to those who are disobedient, "The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone,"
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you who trust him recognize the honor God has given him. But for those who reject him, "The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone."
verses.textEnNasb: This precious value, then, is for you who believe; but for unbelievers, "A stone which the builders rejected, This became the chief cornerstone,"
verses.textEn: Now to you who believe, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, "The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,"

verses.textZh: 它又 "作了绊脚的石头， 使人跌倒的盘石。" 他们跌倒是因为不顺从这道，他们这样是必然的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它又 "作了绊脚的石头， 使人跌倒的盘石。" 他们跌倒是因为不顺从这道，他们这样是必然的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：作了绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石。他们既不顺从，就在道理上绊跌 ；他们这样绊跌也是预定的。
verses.textEnNiv: and, "A stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall." They stumble because they disobey the message—which is also what they were destined for.
verses.textEnEsv: and "A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense." They stumble because they disobey the word, as they were destined to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: and "A stone of stumbling And a rock of offense." They stumble, being disobedient to the word, to which they also were appointed.
verses.textEnNlt: And, "He is the stone that makes people stumble, the rock that makes them fall." They stumble because they do not obey God’s word, and so they meet the fate that was planned for them.
verses.textEnNasb: and, "A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense"; for they stumble because they are disobedient to the word, and to this they were also appointed.
verses.textEn: and, "A stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall." They stumble because they disobey the message—which is also what they were destined for.

verses.textZh: 然而你们是蒙拣选的族类，是君尊的祭司，是圣洁的国民，是属神的子民，为要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而你们是蒙拣选的族类，是君尊的祭司，是圣洁的国民，是属神的子民，为要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有你们是被拣选的族类，是有君尊的祭司，是圣洁的国度，是属神的子民，要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
verses.textEnNiv: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.
verses.textEnEsv: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession, that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;
verses.textEnNlt: But you are not like that, for you are a chosen people. You are royal priests, a holy nation, God’s very own possession. As a result, you can show others the goodness of God, for he called you out of the darkness into his wonderful light.
verses.textEnNasb: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people forGod’s own possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;
verses.textEn: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.

verses.textZh: "你们从前不是子民， 现在却是神的子民； 从前未蒙怜恤， 现在却蒙了怜恤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们从前不是子民， 现在却是神的子民； 从前未蒙怜恤， 现在却蒙了怜恤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从前算不得子民， 现在却作了神的子民； 从前未曾蒙怜恤， 现在却蒙了怜恤。
verses.textEnNiv: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: who once were not a people but are now the people of God, who had not obtained mercy but now have obtained mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Once you had no identity as a people; now you are God’s people. Once you received no mercy; now you have received God’s mercy."
verses.textEnNasb: for you once were not a people, but now you are the people of God; you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
verses.textEn: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，我劝你们作客旅和寄居的人，要禁戒肉体的私欲，这私欲是与灵魂争战的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，我劝你们作客旅和寄居的人，要禁戒肉体的私欲，这私欲是与灵魂争战的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们是客旅，是寄居的。我劝你们要禁戒肉体的私欲；这私欲是与灵魂争战的。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from sinful desires, which wage war against your soul.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, I urge you as sojourners and exiles to abstain from the passions of the flesh, which wage war against your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, I beg you as sojourners and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, I warn you as "temporary residents and foreigners" to keep away from worldly desires that wage war against your very souls.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and strangers to abstain from fleshly lusts, which wage war against the soul.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from sinful desires, which wage war against your soul.

verses.textZh: 你们在教外人中，应当品行端正，使那些人，虽然毁谤你们是作恶的，但因为看见你们的好行为，就要在鉴察的日子颂赞神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在教外人中，应当品行端正，使那些人，虽然毁谤你们是作恶的，但因为看见你们的好行为，就要在鉴察的日子颂赞神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在外邦人中，应当品行端正，叫那些毁谤你们是作恶的，因看见你们的好行为，便在鉴察 的日子归荣耀给神。
verses.textEnNiv: Live such good lives among the pagans that, though they accuse you of doing wrong, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day he visits us.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep your conduct among the Gentiles honorable, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation.
verses.textEnNkjv: having your conduct honorable among the Gentiles, that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may, by your good works which they observe, glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful to live properly among your unbelieving neighbors. Then even if they accuse you of doing wrong, they will see your honorable behavior, and they will give honor to God when he judges the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Keep your behavior excellent among the Gentiles, so that in the thing in which they slander you as evildoers, they may because of your good deeds, as they observe them, glorify God on the day of visitation.
verses.textEn: Live such good lives among the pagans that, though they accuse you of doing wrong, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day he visits us.

verses.textZh: 你们为主的缘故，要顺服人的一切制度，无论是至尊的君王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为主的缘故，要顺服人的一切制度，无论是至尊的君王，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为主的缘故，要顺服人的一切制度，或是在上的君王，
verses.textEnNiv: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human authority: whether to the emperor, as the supreme authority,
verses.textEnEsv: Be subject for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether it be to the emperor as supreme,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake, whether to the king as supreme,
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord’s sake, submit to all human authority—whether the king as head of state,
verses.textEnNasb: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to a king as the one in authority,
verses.textEn: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human authority: whether to the emperor, as the supreme authority,

verses.textZh: 或是君王所派赏善罚恶的官员；
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是君王所派赏善罚恶的官员；
verses.textZhCuv: 或是君王所派罚恶赏善的臣宰。
verses.textEnNiv: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.
verses.textEnEsv: or to governors as sent by him to punish those who do evil and to praise those who do good.
verses.textEnNkjv: or to governors, as to those who are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers and forthe praise of those who do good.
verses.textEnNlt: or the officials he has appointed. For the king has sent them to punish those who do wrong and to honor those who do right.
verses.textEnNasb: or to governors as sent by him for the punishment of evildoers and the praise of those who do right.
verses.textEn: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.

verses.textZh: 因为这是神的旨意，要借着你们的善行，塞住糊涂无知人的口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这是神的旨意，要借着你们的善行，塞住糊涂无知人的口。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神的旨意原是要你们行善，可以堵住那糊涂无知人的口。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish people.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men—
verses.textEnNlt: It is God’s will that your honorable lives should silence those ignorant people who make foolish accusations against you.
verses.textEnNasb: For such is the will of God, that by doing right you silence the ignorance of foolish people.
verses.textEn: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish people.

verses.textZh: 你们是自由的人，但不要用自由来掩饰邪恶，总要像神的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是自由的人，但不要用自由来掩饰邪恶，总要像神的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们虽是自由的，却不可藉着自由遮盖恶毒 ，总要作神的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as God’s slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: Live as people who are free, not using your freedom as a cover-up for evil, but living as servants of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: as free, yet not using liberty as a cloak for vice, but as bondservants of God.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are free, yet you are God’s slaves, so don’t use your freedom as an excuse to do evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Act as free people, and do not use your freedom as a covering for evil, but use it as bond-servants of God.
verses.textEn: Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as God’s slaves.

verses.textZh: 要尊重众人，爱护弟兄，敬畏神，尊敬君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要尊重众人，爱护弟兄，敬畏神，尊敬君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 务要尊敬众人，亲爱教中的弟兄，敬畏神，尊敬君王。
verses.textEnNiv: Show proper respect to everyone, love the family of believers, fear God, honor the emperor.
verses.textEnEsv: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the emperor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Honor all people. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Respect everyone, and love the family of believers. Fear God, and respect the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Honor all people, love the brotherhood, fear God, honor the king.
verses.textEn: Show proper respect to everyone, love the family of believers, fear God, honor the emperor.

verses.textZh: 你们作仆人的，要凡事敬畏顺服主人，不单是对善良温和的，就是乖僻的也要顺服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作仆人的，要凡事敬畏顺服主人，不单是对善良温和的，就是乖僻的也要顺服。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作仆人的，凡事要存敬畏的心顺服主人；不但顺服那善良温和的，就是那乖僻的也要顺服。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaves, in reverent fear of God submit yourselves to your masters, not only to those who are good and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.
verses.textEnEsv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust.
verses.textEnNkjv: Servants, be submissive to your masters with all fear, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the harsh.
verses.textEnNlt: You who are slaves must submit to your masters with all respect. Do what they tell you—not only if they are kind and reasonable, but even if they are cruel.
verses.textEnNasb: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but also to those who are harsh.
verses.textEn: Slaves, in reverent fear of God submit yourselves to your masters, not only to those who are good and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.

verses.textZh: 因为人若在神面前为良心的缘故，忍受冤屈的苦楚，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人若在神面前为良心的缘故，忍受冤屈的苦楚，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若人为叫良心对得住神，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，这是可喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is commendable if someone bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because they are conscious of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is a gracious thing, when, mindful of God, one endures sorrows while suffering unjustly.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is commendable, if because of conscience toward God one endures grief, suffering wrongfully.
verses.textEnNlt: For God is pleased when, conscious of his will, you patiently endure unjust treatment.
verses.textEnNasb: For this finds favor, if for the sake of conscience toward God a person endures grief when suffering unjustly.
verses.textEn: For it is commendable if someone bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because they are conscious of God.

verses.textZh: 你们若因犯罪受责打而能忍耐，有甚么可夸的呢？但你们若因行善而受苦，能忍耐，在神看来，这是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若因犯罪受责打而能忍耐，有甚么可夸的呢？但你们若因行善而受苦，能忍耐，在神看来，这是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若因犯罪受责打，能忍耐，有什么可夸的呢？但你们若因行善受苦，能忍耐，这在神看是可喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
verses.textEnEsv: For what credit is it if, when you sin and are beaten for it, you endure? But if when you do good and suffer for it you endure, this is a gracious thing in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For what credit isit if, when you are beaten for your faults, you take it patiently? But when you do good and suffer, if you take it patiently, this is commendable before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Of course, you get no credit for being patient if you are beaten for doing wrong. But if you suffer for doing good and endure it patiently, God is pleased with you.
verses.textEnNasb: For what credit is there if, when you sin and are harshly treated, you endure it with patience? But if when you do what is right and suffer for it you patiently endure it, this finds favor with God.
verses.textEn: But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

verses.textZh: 你们就是为此蒙召，因基督也为你们受过苦，给你们留下榜样，叫你们跟随他的脚踪行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就是为此蒙召，因基督也为你们受过苦，给你们留下榜样，叫你们跟随他的脚踪行。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们蒙召原是为此；因基督也为你们受过苦，给你们留下榜样，叫你们跟随他的脚踪行。
verses.textEnNiv: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.
verses.textEnEsv: For to this you have been called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you might follow in his steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow His steps:
verses.textEnNlt: For God called you to do good, even if it means suffering, just as Christ suffered for you. He is your example, and you must follow in his steps.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have been called for this purpose, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you would follow in His steps,
verses.textEn: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.

verses.textZh: "他从来没有犯过罪， 口里也找不到诡诈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "他从来没有犯过罪， 口里也找不到诡诈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他并没有犯罪，口里也没有诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: "He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth."
verses.textEnEsv: He committed no sin, neither was deceit found in his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who committed no sin, Nor was deceit found in His mouth";
verses.textEnNlt: He never sinned, nor ever deceived anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: He who committed no sin, nor was any deceit found in His mouth;
verses.textEn: "He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth."

verses.textZh: 他被骂的时候不还嘴，受苦的时候也不说恐吓的话；只把自己交托给那公义的审判者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被骂的时候不还嘴，受苦的时候也不说恐吓的话；只把自己交托给那公义的审判者。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被骂不还口；受害不说威吓的话，只将自己交托那按公义审判人的主。
verses.textEnNiv: When they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly.
verses.textEnEsv: When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but continued entrusting himself to him who judges justly.
verses.textEnNkjv: who, when He was reviled, did not revile in return; when He suffered, He did not threaten, but committed Himself to Him who judges righteously;
verses.textEnNlt: He did not retaliate when he was insulted, nor threaten revenge when he suffered. He left his case in the hands of God, who always judges fairly.
verses.textEnNasb: and while being abusively insulted, He did not insult in return; while suffering, He did not threaten, but kept entrusting Himself to Him who judges righteously;
verses.textEn: When they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly.

verses.textZh: 他在木头上亲身担当了我们的罪，使我们既然不活在罪中，就可以为义而活。因他受的鞭伤，你们就得了医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在木头上亲身担当了我们的罪，使我们既然不活在罪中，就可以为义而活。因他受的鞭伤，你们就得了医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被挂在木头上，亲身担当了我们的罪，使我们既然在罪上死，就得以在义上活。因他受的鞭伤，你们便得了医治。
verses.textEnNiv: "He himself bore our sins" in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; "by his wounds you have been healed."
verses.textEnEsv: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: who Himself bore our sins in His own body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live for righteousness— by whose stripes you were healed.
verses.textEnNlt: He personally carried our sins in his body on the cross so that we can be dead to sin and live for what is right. By his wounds you are healed.
verses.textEnNasb: and He Himself brought our sins in His body up on the cross, so that we might die to sin and live for righteousness; by His wounds you were healed.
verses.textEn: "He himself bore our sins" in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; "by his wounds you have been healed."

verses.textZh: 你们从前好象迷路的羊，但现在已经回到你们灵魂的牧人和监督那里了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们从前好象迷路的羊，但现在已经回到你们灵魂的牧人和监督那里了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从前好像迷路的羊，如今却归到你们灵魂的牧人监督了。
verses.textEnNiv: For "you were like sheep going astray," but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
verses.textEnEsv: For you were straying like sheep, but have now returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you were like sheep going astray, but have now returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
verses.textEnNlt: Once you were like sheep who wandered away. But now you have turned to your Shepherd, the Guardian of your souls.
verses.textEnNasb: For you were continually straying like sheep, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Guardian of your souls.
verses.textEn: For "you were like sheep going astray," but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

verses.textZh: 照样，你们作妻子的，要顺服自己的丈夫，好使不信道的丈夫受到感动，不是因着你们的言语，而是因着你们的生活，
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，你们作妻子的，要顺服自己的丈夫，好使不信道的丈夫受到感动，不是因着你们的言语，而是因着你们的生活，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作妻子的要顺服自己的丈夫；这样，若有不信从道理的丈夫，他们虽然不听道，也可以因妻子的品行被感化过来；
verses.textEnNiv: Wives, in the same way submit yourselves to your own husbands so that, if any of them do not believe the word, they may be won over without words by the behavior of their wives,
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,
verses.textEnNkjv: Wives, likewise, be submissive to your own husbands, that even if some do not obey the word, they, without a word, may be won by the conduct of their wives,
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, you wives must accept the authority of your husbands. Then, even if some refuse to obey the Good News, your godly lives will speak to them without any words. They will be won over
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way, you wives, be subject to your own husbands so that even if any of them are disobedient to the word, they may be won over without a word by the behavior of their wives,
verses.textEn: Wives, in the same way submit yourselves to your own husbands so that, if any of them do not believe the word, they may be won over without words by the behavior of their wives,

verses.textZh: 因为他们看见了你们敬畏和纯洁的生活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们看见了你们敬畏和纯洁的生活。
verses.textZhCuv: 这正是因看见你们有贞洁的品行和敬畏的心。
verses.textEnNiv: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.
verses.textEnEsv: when they see your respectful and pure conduct.
verses.textEnNkjv: when they observe your chaste conduct accompanied by fear.
verses.textEnNlt: by observing your pure and reverent lives.
verses.textEnNasb: as they observe your pure and respectful behavior.
verses.textEn: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.

verses.textZh: 不要单注重外表的装饰，就如鬈头发、戴金饰、穿华丽衣服；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要单注重外表的装饰，就如鬈头发、戴金饰、穿华丽衣服；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要以外面的辫头发，戴金饰，穿美衣为妆饰，
verses.textEnNiv: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as elaborate hairstyles and the wearing of gold jewelry or fine clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry, or the clothing you wear—
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let your adornment be merely outward—arranging the hair, wearing gold, or putting on fine apparel—
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be concerned about the outward beauty of fancy hairstyles, expensive jewelry, or beautiful clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: Your adornment must not be merely the external—braiding the hair, wearing gold jewelry, or putting on apparel;
verses.textEn: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as elaborate hairstyles and the wearing of gold jewelry or fine clothes.

verses.textZh: 却要在里面存着温柔安静的心灵，作不能毁坏的装饰，这在神面前是极宝贵的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却要在里面存着温柔安静的心灵，作不能毁坏的装饰，这在神面前是极宝贵的。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要以里面存着长久温柔、安静的心为妆饰；这在神面前是极宝贵的。
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God’s sight.
verses.textEnEsv: but let your adorning be the hidden person of the heart with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God’s sight is very precious.
verses.textEnNkjv: rather letitbe the hidden person of the heart, with the incorruptible beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNlt: You should clothe yourselves instead with the beauty that comes from within, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is so precious to God.
verses.textEnNasb: but it should be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: Rather, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God’s sight.

verses.textZh: 因为古时仰望神的圣洁妇女，正是这样装饰自己，顺服丈夫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为古时仰望神的圣洁妇女，正是这样装饰自己，顺服丈夫，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为古时仰赖神的圣洁妇人正是以此为妆饰，顺服自己的丈夫，
verses.textEnNiv: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to adorn themselves. They submitted themselves to their own husbands,
verses.textEnEsv: For this is how the holy women who hoped in God used to adorn themselves, by submitting to their own husbands,
verses.textEnNkjv: For in this manner, in former times, the holy women who trusted in God also adorned themselves, being submissive to their own husbands,
verses.textEnNlt: This is how the holy women of old made themselves beautiful. They put their trust in God and accepted the authority of their husbands.
verses.textEnNasb: For in this way the holy women of former times, who hoped in God, also used to adorn themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
verses.textEn: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to adorn themselves. They submitted themselves to their own husbands,

verses.textZh: 像撒拉听从亚伯拉罕，称他为主一样；你们若行善，不怕任何恐吓，就是撒拉的女儿了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 像撒拉听从亚伯拉罕，称他为主一样；你们若行善，不怕任何恐吓，就是撒拉的女儿了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就如撒拉听从亚伯拉罕，称他为主。你们若行善，不因恐吓而害怕，便是撒拉的女儿了。
verses.textEnNiv: like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her lord. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not give way to fear.
verses.textEnEsv: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you are her children, if you do good and do not fear anything that is frightening.
verses.textEnNkjv: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose daughters you are if you do good and are not afraid with any terror.
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, Sarah obeyed her husband, Abraham, and called him her master. You are her daughters when you do what is right without fear of what your husbands might do.
verses.textEnNasb: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; and you have proved to be her children if you do what is right without being frightened by any fear.
verses.textEn: like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her lord. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not give way to fear.

verses.textZh: 照样，你们作丈夫的，也要合情合理的与妻子同住。要体谅她比你软弱，要尊敬她，因为她是和你一同承受生命的恩典的。这样，就使你们的祷告不受拦阻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，你们作丈夫的，也要合情合理的与妻子同住。要体谅她比你软弱，要尊敬她，因为她是和你一同承受生命的恩典的。这样，就使你们的祷告不受拦阻。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作丈夫的也要按情理 和妻子同住；因她比你软弱 ，与你一同承受生命之恩的，所以要敬重她。这样，便叫你们的祷告没有阻碍。
verses.textEnNiv: Husbands, in the same way be considerate as you live with your wives, and treat them with respect as the weaker partner and as heirs with you of the gracious gift of life, so that nothing will hinder your prayers.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, husbands, live with your wives in an understanding way, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel, since they are heirs with you of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Husbands, likewise, dwell with them with understanding, giving honor to the wife, as to the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, you husbands must give honor to your wives. Treat your wife with understanding as you live together. She may be weaker than you are, but she is your equal partner in God’s gift of new life. Treat her as you should so your prayers will not be hindered.
verses.textEnNasb: You husbands in the same way, live with your wives in an understanding way, as with someone weaker, since she is a woman; and show her honor as a fellow heir of the grace of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
verses.textEn: Husbands, in the same way be considerate as you live with your wives, and treat them with respect as the weaker partner and as heirs with you of the gracious gift of life, so that nothing will hinder your prayers.

verses.textZh: 总括来说，你们要彼此同心，互相体恤，亲爱像弟兄，满有温柔，存心谦卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总括来说，你们要彼此同心，互相体恤，亲爱像弟兄，满有温柔，存心谦卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 总而言之，你们都要同心，彼此体恤，相爱如弟兄，存慈怜谦卑的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, all of you, be like-minded, be sympathetic, love one another, be compassionate and humble.
verses.textEnEsv: Finally, all of you, have unity of mind, sympathy, brotherly love, a tender heart, and a humble mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally, all ofyoube of one mind, having compassion for one another; love as brothers, be tenderhearted, be courteous;
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, all of you should be of one mind. Sympathize with each other. Love each other as brothers and sisters. Be tenderhearted, and keep a humble attitude.
verses.textEnNasb: To sum up, all of you be harmonious, sympathetic, loving, compassionate, and humble;
verses.textEn: Finally, all of you, be like-minded, be sympathetic, love one another, be compassionate and humble.

verses.textZh: 不要以恶报恶，以辱骂还辱骂，倒要祝福，因为你们就是为此蒙召，好叫你们承受福气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要以恶报恶，以辱骂还辱骂，倒要祝福，因为你们就是为此蒙召，好叫你们承受福气。
verses.textZhCuv: 不以恶报恶，以辱骂还辱骂，倒要祝福；因你们是为此蒙召，好叫你们承受福气。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult. On the contrary, repay evil with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not repay evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, bless, for to this you were called, that you may obtain a blessing.
verses.textEnNkjv: not returning evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t repay evil for evil. Don’t retaliate with insults when people insult you. Instead, pay them back with a blessing. That is what God has called you to do, and he will grant you his blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: not returning evil for evil or insult for insult, but giving a blessing instead; for you were called for the very purpose that you would inherit a blessing.
verses.textEn: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult. On the contrary, repay evil with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

verses.textZh: 因为 "凡希望享受人生， 要看见好日子的， 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为 "凡希望享受人生， 要看见好日子的， 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上说： 人若爱生命， 愿享美福， 须要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话；
verses.textEnNiv: For, "Whoever would love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from deceitful speech.
verses.textEnEsv: For "Whoever desires to love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit;
verses.textEnNkjv: For "He who would love life And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips from speaking deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures say, "If you want to enjoy life and see many happy days, keep your tongue from speaking evil and your lips from telling lies.
verses.textEnNasb: For, "The one who desires life, to love and see good days, Must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
verses.textEn: For, "Whoever would love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from deceitful speech.

verses.textZh: 也要离恶行善， 寻找并追求和睦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要离恶行善， 寻找并追求和睦。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要离恶行善， 寻求和睦，一心追赶。
verses.textEnNiv: They must turn from evil and do good; they must seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEnEsv: let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him turn away from evil and do good; Let him seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn away from evil and do good. Search for peace, and work to maintain it.
verses.textEnNasb: "He must turn away from evil and do good; He must seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEn: They must turn from evil and do good; they must seek peace and pursue it.

verses.textZh: 因为主的眼睛看顾义人， 他的耳朵垂听他们的呼求； 但主的脸敌对作恶的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主的眼睛看顾义人， 他的耳朵垂听他们的呼求； 但主的脸敌对作恶的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，主的眼看顾义人； 主的耳听他们的祈祷。 惟有行恶的人，主向他们变脸。
verses.textEnNiv: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."
verses.textEnEsv: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the eyes of the Lordare on the righteous, And His ears areopen to their prayers; But the face of the Lordis against those who do evil."
verses.textEnNlt: The eyes of the Lord watch over those who do right, and his ears are open to their prayers. But the Lord turns his face against those who do evil."
verses.textEnNasb: "For the eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, And His ears attend to their prayer, But the face of the Lord is against evildoers."
verses.textEn: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

verses.textZh: 如果你们热心行善，有谁能害你们呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们热心行善，有谁能害你们呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若是热心行善，有谁害你们呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?
verses.textEnEsv: Now who is there to harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
verses.textEnNkjv: And who is he who will harm you if you become followers of what is good?
verses.textEnNlt: Now, who will want to harm you if you are eager to do good?
verses.textEnNasb: And who is there to harm you if you prove zealous for what is good?
verses.textEn: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?

verses.textZh: 就算你们要为义受苦，也是有福的。"不要怕人的恐吓，也不要畏惧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就算你们要为义受苦，也是有福的。"不要怕人的恐吓，也不要畏惧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就是为义受苦，也是有福的。不要怕人的威吓 ，也不要惊慌；
verses.textEnNiv: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. "Do not fear their threats ; do not be frightened."
verses.textEnEsv: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you will be blessed. Have no fear of them, nor be troubled,
verses.textEnNkjv: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, youare blessed. "And do not be afraid of their threats, nor be troubled."
verses.textEnNlt: But even if you suffer for doing what is right, God will reward you for it. So don’t worry or be afraid of their threats.
verses.textEnNasb: But even if you should suffer for the sake of righteousness, you are blessed. And do not fear their intimidation, and do not be in dread,
verses.textEn: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. "Do not fear their threats ; do not be frightened."

verses.textZh: 只要心里尊基督为圣，以他为主；常常作好准备，去回答那些问你们为甚么怀有盼望的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要心里尊基督为圣，以他为主；常常作好准备，去回答那些问你们为甚么怀有盼望的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 只要心里尊主基督为圣。有人问你们心中盼望的缘由，就要常作准备，以温柔、敬畏的心回答各人；
verses.textEnNiv: But in your hearts revere Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect,
verses.textEnEsv: but in your hearts honor Christ the Lord as holy, always being prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you; yet do it with gentleness and respect,
verses.textEnNkjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts, and always be ready to give a defense to everyone who asks you a reason for the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear;
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you must worship Christ as Lord of your life. And if someone asks about your hope as a believer, always be ready to explain it.
verses.textEnNasb: but sanctify Christ as Lord in your hearts, always being ready to make a defense to everyone who asks you to give an account for the hope that is in you, but with gentleness and respect;
verses.textEn: But in your hearts revere Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect,

verses.textZh: 但要用温柔敬畏的心回答。当存无愧的良心，使那些诬赖你们这在基督里有好品行的人，在毁谤你们的事上蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但要用温柔敬畏的心回答。当存无愧的良心，使那些诬赖你们这在基督里有好品行的人，在毁谤你们的事上蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 存着无亏的良心，叫你们在何事上被毁谤，就在何事上可以叫那诬赖你们在基督里有好品行的人自觉羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who speak maliciously against your good behavior in Christ may be ashamed of their slander.
verses.textEnEsv: having a good conscience, so that, when you are slandered, those who revile your good behavior in Christ may be put to shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: having a good conscience, that when they defame you as evildoers, those who revile your good conduct in Christ may be ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: But do this in a gentle and respectful way. Keep your conscience clear. Then if people speak against you, they will be ashamed when they see what a good life you live because you belong to Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: and keep a good conscience so that in the thing in which you are slandered, those who disparage your good behavior in Christ will be put to shame.
verses.textEn: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who speak maliciously against your good behavior in Christ may be ashamed of their slander.

verses.textZh: 如果神的旨意是要你们受苦，那么为行善受苦，总比为行恶受苦好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果神的旨意是要你们受苦，那么为行善受苦，总比为行恶受苦好。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的旨意若是叫你们因行善受苦，总强如因行恶受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God’s will, than for doing evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis better, if it is the will of God, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, it is better to suffer for doing good, if that is what God wants, than to suffer for doing wrong!
verses.textEnNasb: For it is better, if God should will it so, that you suffer for doing what is right rather than for doing what is wrong.
verses.textEn: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

verses.textZh: 因为基督也曾一次为你们的罪死了，就是义的代替不义的，为要领你们到神面前。就肉体的方面说，他曾死去；就灵的方面说，他复活了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为基督也曾一次为你们的罪死了，就是义的代替不义的，为要领你们到神面前。就肉体的方面说，他曾死去；就灵的方面说，他复活了；
verses.textZhCuv: 因基督也曾一次为罪受苦 ，就是义的代替不义的，为要引我们到神面前。按着肉体说，他被治死；按着灵性说，他复活了。
verses.textEnNiv: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh but made alive in the spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the just for the unjust, that He might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh but made alive by the Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: Christ suffered for our sins once for all time. He never sinned, but he died for sinners to bring you safely home to God. He suffered physical death, but he was raised to life in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all time, the just for the unjust, so that He might bring us to God, having been put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
verses.textEn: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 他藉这灵也曾去向那些在监管中的灵宣讲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他藉这灵也曾去向那些在监管中的灵宣讲，
verses.textZhCuv: 他藉这灵曾去传道给那些在监狱里的灵听，
verses.textEnNiv: After being made alive, he went and made proclamation to the imprisoned spirits—
verses.textEnEsv: in which he went and proclaimed to the spirits in prison,
verses.textEnNkjv: by whom also He went and preached to the spirits in prison,
verses.textEnNlt: So he went and preached to the spirits in prison—
verses.textEnNasb: in which He also went and made proclamation to the spirits in prison,
verses.textEn: After being made alive, he went and made proclamation to the imprisoned spirits—

verses.textZh: 他们就是挪亚建造方舟的日子、神容忍等待的时候，那些不顺从的人。当时进入方舟、借着水得救的人不多，只有八个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就是挪亚建造方舟的日子、神容忍等待的时候，那些不顺从的人。当时进入方舟、借着水得救的人不多，只有八个。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是那从前在挪亚预备方舟、神容忍等待的时候，不信从的人。当时进入方舟，藉着水得救的不多，只有八个人。
verses.textEnNiv: to those who were disobedient long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In it only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water,
verses.textEnEsv: because they formerly did not obey, when God’s patience waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared, in which a few, that is, eight persons, were brought safely through water.
verses.textEnNkjv: who formerly were disobedient, when once the Divine longsuffering waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared, in which a few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
verses.textEnNlt: those who disobeyed God long ago when God waited patiently while Noah was building his boat. Only eight people were saved from drowning in that terrible flood.
verses.textEnNasb: who once were disobedient when the patience of God kept waiting in the days of Noah, during the construction of the ark, in which a few, that is, eight persons, were brought safely through the water.
verses.textEn: to those who were disobedient long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In it only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water,

verses.textZh: 这水预表的洗礼，现在也拯救你们：不是除去肉体的污秽，而是借着耶稣基督的复活，向神许愿常存纯洁的良心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这水预表的洗礼，现在也拯救你们：不是除去肉体的污秽，而是借着耶稣基督的复活，向神许愿常存纯洁的良心。
verses.textZhCuv: 这水所表明的洗礼，现在藉着耶稣基督复活也拯救你们；这洗礼本不在乎除掉肉体的污秽，只求在神面前有无亏的良心。
verses.textEnNiv: and this water symbolizes baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God. It saves you by the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: Baptism, which corresponds to this, now saves you, not as a removal of dirt from the body but as an appeal to God for a good conscience, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: There is also an antitype which now saves us—baptism (not the removal of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God), through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: And that water is a picture of baptism, which now saves you, not by removing dirt from your body, but as a response to God from a clean conscience. It is effective because of the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Corresponding to that, baptism now saves you—not the removal of dirt from the flesh, but an appeal to God for a good conscience—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: and this water symbolizes baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God. It saves you by the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

verses.textZh: 基督已进到天上，在神右边，众天使、有权势的、有能力的，都服从了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督已进到天上，在神右边，众天使、有权势的、有能力的，都服从了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣已经进入天堂，在神的右边；众天使和有权柄的，并有能力的，都服从了他。
verses.textEnNiv: who has gone into heaven and is at God’s right hand—with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.
verses.textEnEsv: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers having been subjected to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, angels and authorities and powers having been made subject to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Christ has gone to heaven. He is seated in the place of honor next to God, and all the angels and authorities and powers accept his authority.
verses.textEnNasb: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, after angels and authorities and powers had been subjected to Him.
verses.textEn: who has gone into heaven and is at God’s right hand—with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.

verses.textZh: 基督既然在肉身受过苦，你们也应当以同样的心志装备自己 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督既然在肉身受过苦，你们也应当以同样的心志装备自己 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 基督既在肉身受苦，你们也当将这样的心志作为兵器，因为在肉身受过苦的，就已经与罪断绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because whoever suffers in the body is done with sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Since therefore Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves with the same way of thinking, for whoever has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind, for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
verses.textEnNlt: So then, since Christ suffered physical pain, you must arm yourselves with the same attitude he had, and be ready to suffer, too. For if you have suffered physically for Christ, you have finished with sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since Christ has suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same purpose, because the one who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
verses.textEn: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because whoever suffers in the body is done with sin.

verses.textZh: 好叫你们不再随从人的私欲，只顺从神的旨意，在世上度余下的光阴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好叫你们不再随从人的私欲，只顺从神的旨意，在世上度余下的光阴。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们存这样的心，从今以后就可以不从人的情欲，只从神的旨意在世度余下的光阴。
verses.textEnNiv: As a result, they do not live the rest of their earthly lives for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.
verses.textEnEsv: so as to live for the rest of the time in the flesh no longer for human passions but for the will of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: that he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
verses.textEnNlt: You won’t spend the rest of your lives chasing your own desires, but you will be anxious to do the will of God.
verses.textEnNasb: so as to live the rest of the time in the flesh no longer for human lusts, but for the will of God.
verses.textEn: As a result, they do not live the rest of their earthly lives for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.

verses.textZh: 因为你们过去随从教外人的心意，行邪淫、私欲、醉酒、荒宴、狂饮和可憎拜偶像的事，时候已经够了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们过去随从教外人的心意，行邪淫、私欲、醉酒、荒宴、狂饮和可憎拜偶像的事，时候已经够了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为往日随从外邦人的心意行邪淫、恶欲、醉酒、荒宴、群饮，并可恶拜偶像的事，时候已经够了。
verses.textEnNiv: For you have spent enough time in the past doing what pagans choose to do—living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.
verses.textEnEsv: For the time that is past suffices for doing what the Gentiles want to do, living in sensuality, passions, drunkenness, orgies, drinking parties, and lawless idolatry.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we havespent enough of our past lifetime in doing the will of the Gentiles—when we walked in lewdness, lusts, drunkenness, revelries, drinking parties, and abominable idolatries.
verses.textEnNlt: You have had enough in the past of the evil things that godless people enjoy—their immorality and lust, their feasting and drunkenness and wild parties, and their terrible worship of idols.
verses.textEnNasb: For the time already past is sufficient for you to have carried out the desire of the Gentiles, having pursued a course of indecent behavior, lusts, drunkenness, carousing, drinking parties, and wanton idolatries.
verses.textEn: For you have spent enough time in the past doing what pagans choose to do—living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.

verses.textZh: 他们见你们不再与他们同奔那纵情放荡的路，就觉得奇怪，毁谤你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们见你们不再与他们同奔那纵情放荡的路，就觉得奇怪，毁谤你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在这些事上，见你们不与他们同奔那放荡无度的路，就以为怪，毁谤你们。
