verses.textEnNiv: They are surprised that you do not join them in their reckless, wild living, and they heap abuse on you.
verses.textEnEsv: With respect to this they are surprised when you do not join them in the same flood of debauchery, and they malign you;
verses.textEnNkjv: In regard to these, they think it strange that you do not run with them in the same flood of dissipation, speaking evil of you.
verses.textEnNlt: Of course, your former friends are surprised when you no longer plunge into the flood of wild and destructive things they do. So they slander you.
verses.textEnNasb: In all this, they are surprised that you do not run with them in the same excesses of debauchery, and they slander you;
verses.textEn: They are surprised that you do not join them in their reckless, wild living, and they heap abuse on you.

verses.textZh: 他们必要向那位预备要审判活人死人的主交帐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必要向那位预备要审判活人死人的主交帐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必在那将要审判活人死人的主面前交帐。
verses.textEnNiv: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: but they will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: But remember that they will have to face God, who stands ready to judge everyone, both the living and the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: but they will give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.textEn: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

verses.textZh: 因此，那些死人也曾有福音传给他们，好使他们的肉体受了人要受的审判，他们的灵却靠神活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，那些死人也曾有福音传给他们，好使他们的肉体受了人要受的审判，他们的灵却靠神活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此，就是死人也曾有福音传给他们，要叫他们的肉体按着人受审判，他们的灵性却靠神活着。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to human standards in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is why the gospel was preached even to those who are dead, that though judged in the flesh the way people are, they might live in the spirit the way God does.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason the gospel was preached also to those who are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Good News was preached to those who are now dead —so although they were destined to die like all people, they now live forever with God in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: For the gospel has for this purpose been preached even to those who are dead, that though they are judged in the flesh as people, they may live in the spirit according to the will of God.
verses.textEn: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to human standards in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.

verses.textZh: 万物的结局近了，所以你们要谨慎警醒地祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万物的结局近了，所以你们要谨慎警醒地祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 万物的结局近了。所以，你们要谨慎自守，警醒祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: The end of all things is near. Therefore be alert and of sober mind so that you may pray.
verses.textEnEsv: The end of all things is at hand; therefore be self-controlled and sober-minded for the sake of your prayers.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the end of all things is at hand; therefore be serious and watchful in your prayers.
verses.textEnNlt: The end of the world is coming soon. Therefore, be earnest and disciplined in your prayers.
verses.textEnNasb: The end of all things is near; therefore, be of sound judgment and sober spirit for the purpose of prayer.
verses.textEn: The end of all things is near. Therefore be alert and of sober mind so that you may pray.

verses.textZh: 最重要的是要彼此切实相爱，因为爱能遮盖许多的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最重要的是要彼此切实相爱，因为爱能遮盖许多的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 最要紧的是彼此切实相爱，因为爱能遮掩许多的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
verses.textEnEsv: Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: And above all things have fervent love for one another, for "love will cover a multitude of sins."
verses.textEnNlt: Most important of all, continue to show deep love for each other, for love covers a multitude of sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Above all, keep fervent in your love for one another, because love covers a multitude of sins.
verses.textEn: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

verses.textZh: 你们要互相接待，不发怨言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要互相接待，不发怨言。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要互相款待，不发怨言。
verses.textEnNiv: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.
verses.textEnEsv: Show hospitality to one another without grumbling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
verses.textEnNlt: Cheerfully share your home with those who need a meal or a place to stay.
verses.textEnNasb: Be hospitable to one another without complaint.
verses.textEn: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.

verses.textZh: 你们要作神各样恩赐的好管家，各人照着所领受的恩赐彼此服事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要作神各样恩赐的好管家，各人照着所领受的恩赐彼此服事。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人要照所得的恩赐彼此服事，作神百般恩赐的好管家。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s grace in its various forms.
verses.textEnEsv: As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another, as good stewards of God’s varied grace:
verses.textEnNkjv: As each one has received a gift, minister it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
verses.textEnNlt: God has given each of you a gift from his great variety of spiritual gifts. Use them well to serve one another.
verses.textEnNasb: As each one has received a special gift, employ it in serving one another as good stewards of the multifaceted grace of God.
verses.textEn: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s grace in its various forms.

verses.textZh: 讲道的，应当按着神的圣言讲；服事的，应当按着神所赐的力量服事，为要在一切事上，使神藉耶稣基督得荣耀。荣耀、权能都是他的，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 讲道的，应当按着神的圣言讲；服事的，应当按着神所赐的力量服事，为要在一切事上，使神藉耶稣基督得荣耀。荣耀、权能都是他的，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有讲道的，要按着神的圣言讲；若有服事人的，要按着神所赐的力量服事，叫神在凡事上因耶稣基督得荣耀。原来荣耀、权能都是他的，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone speaks, they should do so as one who speaks the very words of God. If anyone serves, they should do so with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be praised through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: whoever speaks, as one who speaks oracles of God; whoever serves, as one who serves by the strength that God supplies—in order that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ. To him belong glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone speaks, lethimspeak as the oracles of God. If anyone ministers, lethimdoit as with the ability which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Do you have the gift of speaking? Then speak as though God himself were speaking through you. Do you have the gift of helping others? Do it with all the strength and energy that God supplies. Then everything you do will bring glory to God through Jesus Christ. All glory and power to him forever and ever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever speaks is to do so as one who is speaking actual words of God; whoever serves is to do so as one who is serving by the strength which God supplies; so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belongs the glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEn: If anyone speaks, they should do so as one who speaks the very words of God. If anyone serves, they should do so with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be praised through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，有火炼的试验临到你们，不要以为奇怪，好象是遭遇非常的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，有火炼的试验临到你们，不要以为奇怪，好象是遭遇非常的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，有火炼的试验临到你们，不要以为奇怪（似乎是遭遇非常的事），
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial when it comes upon you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, do not think it strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened to you;
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, don’t be surprised at the fiery trials you are going through, as if something strange were happening to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal among you, which comes upon you for your testing, as though something strange were happening to you;
verses.textEn: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.

verses.textZh: 倒要欢喜，因为你们既然在基督的受苦上有分，就在他荣耀显现的时候，可以欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 倒要欢喜，因为你们既然在基督的受苦上有分，就在他荣耀显现的时候，可以欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 倒要欢喜；因为你们是与基督一同受苦，使你们在他荣耀显现的时候，也可以欢喜快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: But rejoice inasmuch as you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: But rejoice insofar as you share Christ’s sufferings, that you may also rejoice and be glad when his glory is revealed.
verses.textEnNkjv: but rejoice to the extent that you partake of Christ’s sufferings, that when His glory is revealed, you may also be glad with exceeding joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, be very glad—for these trials make you partners with Christ in his suffering, so that you will have the wonderful joy of seeing his glory when it is revealed to all the world.
verses.textEnNasb: but to the degree that you share the sufferings of Christ, keep on rejoicing, so that at the revelation of His glory you may also rejoice and be overjoyed.
verses.textEn: But rejoice inasmuch as you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.

verses.textZh: 你们要是为基督的名受辱骂，就有福了！因为神荣耀的灵，住在你们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要是为基督的名受辱骂，就有福了！因为神荣耀的灵，住在你们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若为基督的名受辱骂，便是有福的；因为神荣耀的灵常住在你们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
verses.textEnEsv: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed areyou, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests upon you. On their part He is blasphemed, but on your part He is glorified.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are insulted because you bear the name of Christ, you will be blessed, for the glorious Spirit of God rests upon you.
verses.textEnNasb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory, and of God, rests upon you.
verses.textEn: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

verses.textZh: 你们中间不可有人因为杀人、或偷窃、或行恶、或好管闲事而受苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间不可有人因为杀人、或偷窃、或行恶、或好管闲事而受苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间却不可有人因为杀人、偷窃、作恶、好管闲事而受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: If you suffer, it should not be as a murderer or thief or any other kind of criminal, or even as a meddler.
verses.textEnEsv: But let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or an evildoer or as a meddler.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, a thief, an evildoer, or as a busybody in other people’s matters.
verses.textEnNlt: If you suffer, however, it must not be for murder, stealing, making trouble, or prying into other people’s affairs.
verses.textEnNasb: Make sure that none of you suffers as a murderer, or thief, or evildoer, or a troublesome meddler;
verses.textEn: If you suffer, it should not be as a murderer or thief or any other kind of criminal, or even as a meddler.

verses.textZh: 如果因为作基督徒而受苦，不要以为羞耻，倒要借着这名字荣耀神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果因为作基督徒而受苦，不要以为羞耻，倒要借着这名字荣耀神。
verses.textZhCuv: 若为作基督徒受苦，却不要羞耻，倒要因这名归荣耀给神。
verses.textEnNiv: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet if anyone suffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in that name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet if anyonesuffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: But it is no shame to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God for the privilege of being called by his name!
verses.textEnNasb: but if anyone suffers as a Christian, he is not to be ashamed, but is to glorify God in this name.
verses.textEn: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.

verses.textZh: 因为审判从神的家开始，就在这时候了。如果先从我们起头，那不信从神福音的人，结局将要怎样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为审判从神的家开始，就在这时候了。如果先从我们起头，那不信从神福音的人，结局将要怎样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为时候到了，审判要从神的家起首。若是先从我们起首，那不信从神福音的人将有何等的结局呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For it is time for judgment to begin with God’s household; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the gospel of God?
verses.textEnEsv: For it is time for judgment to begin at the household of God; and if it begins with us, what will be the outcome for those who do not obey the gospel of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: For the time hascome for judgment to begin at the house of God; and if itbegins with us first, what will be the end of those who do not obey the gospel of God?
verses.textEnNlt: For the time has come for judgment, and it must begin with God’s household. And if judgment begins with us, what terrible fate awaits those who have never obeyed God’s Good News?
verses.textEnNasb: For it is time for judgment to begin with the household of God; and if it begins with us first, what will be the outcome for those who do not obey the gospel of God?
verses.textEn: For it is time for judgment to begin with God’s household; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the gospel of God?

verses.textZh: "如果义人仅仅得救， 不敬虔和犯罪的人，又会变成怎样呢 ？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果义人仅仅得救， 不敬虔和犯罪的人，又会变成怎样呢 ？"
verses.textZhCuv: 若是义人仅仅得救，那不虔敬和犯罪的人将有何地可站呢？
verses.textEnNiv: And, "If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"
verses.textEnEsv: And "If the righteous is scarcely saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now "If the righteous one is scarcely saved, Where will the ungodly and the sinner appear?"
verses.textEnNlt: And also, "If the righteous are barely saved, what will happen to godless sinners?"
verses.textEnNasb: And if it is with difficulty that the righteous is saved, what will become of the godless man and the sinner?
verses.textEn: And, "If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"

verses.textZh: 所以那顺着神的旨意而受苦的人，要继续地行善，把自己的生命交托那信实的创造者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以那顺着神的旨意而受苦的人，要继续地行善，把自己的生命交托那信实的创造者。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，那照神旨意受苦的人要一心为善，将自己灵魂交与那信实的造化之主。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let those who suffer according to God’s will entrust their souls to a faithful Creator while doing good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let those who suffer according to the will of God commit their souls toHim in doing good, as to a faithful Creator.
verses.textEnNlt: So if you are suffering in a manner that pleases God, keep on doing what is right, and trust your lives to the God who created you, for he will never fail you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, those also who suffer according to the will of God are to entrust their souls to a faithful Creator in doing what is right.
verses.textEn: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

verses.textZh: 我这同作长老，也是为基督受苦作见证，又是同享将来所要显现的荣耀的，劝你们当中作长老的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这同作长老，也是为基督受苦作见证，又是同享将来所要显现的荣耀的，劝你们当中作长老的：
verses.textZhCuv: 我这作长老、作基督受苦的见证、同享后来所要显现之荣耀的，劝你们中间与我同作长老的人：
verses.textEnNiv: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder and a witness of Christ’s sufferings who also will share in the glory to be revealed:
verses.textEnEsv: So I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as a partaker in the glory that is going to be revealed:
verses.textEnNkjv: The elders who are among you I exhort, I who am a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that will be revealed:
verses.textEnNlt: And now, a word to you who are elders in the churches. I, too, am an elder and a witness to the sufferings of Christ. And I, too, will share in his glory when he is revealed to the whole world. As a fellow elder, I appeal to you:
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I urge elders among you, as your fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and one who is also a fellow partaker of the glory that is to be revealed:
verses.textEn: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder and a witness of Christ’s sufferings who also will share in the glory to be revealed:

verses.textZh: 务要牧养在你们中间的神的羊群，按着神的旨意看顾他们。不是出于勉强，而是出于甘心；不是因为贪财，而是出于热诚；
verses.textZhCnvs: 务要牧养在你们中间的神的羊群，按着神的旨意看顾他们。不是出于勉强，而是出于甘心；不是因为贪财，而是出于热诚；
verses.textZhCuv: 务要牧养在你们中间神的群羊，按着神旨意照管他们；不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心；也不是因为贪财，乃是出于乐意；
verses.textEnNiv: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is under your care, watching over them—not because you must, but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not pursuing dishonest gain, but eager to serve;
verses.textEnEsv: shepherd the flock of God that is among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not for shameful gain, but eagerly;
verses.textEnNkjv: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, serving as overseers, not by compulsion but willingly, not for dishonest gain but eagerly;
verses.textEnNlt: Care for the flock that God has entrusted to you. Watch over it willingly, not grudgingly—not for what you will get out of it, but because you are eager to serve God.
verses.textEnNasb: shepherd the flock of God among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion but voluntarily, according to the will of God; and not with greed but with eagerness;
verses.textEn: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is under your care, watching over them—not because you must, but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not pursuing dishonest gain, but eager to serve;

verses.textZh: 也不是要辖制托付你们的羊群，而是作他们的榜样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不是要辖制托付你们的羊群，而是作他们的榜样。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不是辖制所托付你们的，乃是作群羊的榜样。
verses.textEnNiv: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
verses.textEnEsv: not domineering over those in your charge, but being examples to the flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor as being lords over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t lord it over the people assigned to your care, but lead them by your own good example.
verses.textEnNasb: nor yet as domineering over those assigned to your care, but by proving to be examples to the flock.
verses.textEn: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

verses.textZh: 到了牧长显现的时候，你们必定得着那永不衰残的荣耀冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了牧长显现的时候，你们必定得着那永不衰残的荣耀冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了牧长显现的时候，你们必得那永不衰残的荣耀冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: and when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that does not fade away.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the Great Shepherd appears, you will receive a crown of never-ending glory and honor.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
verses.textEn: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

verses.textZh: 照样，你们青年人要顺服年长的。就是你们各人也要彼此以谦卑为装束，因为 "神敌挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，你们青年人要顺服年长的。就是你们各人也要彼此以谦卑为装束，因为 "神敌挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们年幼的，也要顺服年长的。就是你们众人也都要以谦卑束腰，彼此顺服；因为神阻挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, you who are younger, submit yourselves to your elders. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, "God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble."
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, you who are younger, be subject to the elders. Clothe yourselves, all of you, with humility toward one another, for "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise you younger people, submit yourselves to your elders. Yes, all of you be submissive to one another, and be clothed with humility, for "God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, you who are younger must accept the authority of the elders. And all of you, dress yourselves in humility as you relate to one another, for "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEnNasb: You younger men, likewise, be subject to your elders; and all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because God is opposed to the proud, but He gives grace to the humble.
verses.textEn: In the same way, you who are younger, submit yourselves to your elders. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, "God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble."

verses.textZh: 所以你们要谦卑，服在神大能的手下，到了时候，他必叫你们升高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要谦卑，服在神大能的手下，到了时候，他必叫你们升高。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了时候，他必叫你们升高。
verses.textEnNiv: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.
verses.textEnEsv: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God so that at the proper time he may exalt you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time,
verses.textEnNlt: So humble yourselves under the mighty power of God, and at the right time he will lift you up in honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, so that He may exalt you at the proper time,
verses.textEn: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

verses.textZh: 你们要把一切忧虑卸给神，因为他顾念你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把一切忧虑卸给神，因为他顾念你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，因为他顾念你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
verses.textEnEsv: casting all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.
verses.textEnNlt: Give all your worries and cares to God, for he cares about you.
verses.textEnNasb: having cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares about you.
verses.textEn: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨守、警醒。你们的仇敌魔鬼，好象吼叫的狮子走来走去，寻找可以吞吃的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨守、警醒。你们的仇敌魔鬼，好象吼叫的狮子走来走去，寻找可以吞吃的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 务要谨守，警醒。因为你们的仇敌魔鬼，如同吼叫的狮子，遍地游行，寻找可吞吃的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.
verses.textEnEsv: Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil walks about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
verses.textEnNlt: Stay alert! Watch out for your great enemy, the devil. He prowls around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.
verses.textEnNasb: Be of sober spirit, be on the alert. Your adversary, the devil, prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
verses.textEn: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.

verses.textZh: 你们要用坚强的信心抵挡他，因为知道你们在世上的弟兄，也经历过同样的苦难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用坚强的信心抵挡他，因为知道你们在世上的弟兄，也经历过同样的苦难。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要用坚固的信心抵挡他，因为知道你们在世上的众弟兄也是经历这样的苦难。
verses.textEnNiv: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is undergoing the same kind of sufferings.
verses.textEnEsv: Resist him, firm in your faith, knowing that the same kinds of suffering are being experienced by your brotherhood throughout the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Resist him, steadfast in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are experienced by your brotherhood in the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Stand firm against him, and be strong in your faith. Remember that your family of believers all over the world is going through the same kind of suffering you are.
verses.textEnNasb: So resist him, firm in your faith, knowing that the same experiences of suffering are being accomplished by your brothers and sisters who are in the world.
verses.textEn: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is undergoing the same kind of sufferings.

verses.textZh: 但满有恩典的神，就是在基督里召你们进入他永远荣耀的那一位，在你们受了短暂的苦难之后，必定亲自成全你们，坚固你们，赐力量给你们，建立你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但满有恩典的神，就是在基督里召你们进入他永远荣耀的那一位，在你们受了短暂的苦难之后，必定亲自成全你们，坚固你们，赐力量给你们，建立你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那赐诸般恩典的神曾在基督里召你们，得享他永远的荣耀，等你们暂受苦难之后，必要亲自成全你们，坚固你们，赐力量给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast.
verses.textEnEsv: And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But may the God of all grace, who called us to His eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
verses.textEnNlt: In his kindness God called you to share in his eternal glory by means of Christ Jesus. So after you have suffered a little while, he will restore, support, and strengthen you, and he will place you on a firm foundation.
verses.textEnNasb: After you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself perfect, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.
verses.textEn: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast.

verses.textZh: 愿权能归给他，直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿权能归给他，直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: To him be the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: All power to him forever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him be dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEn: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 我借着我认为忠心的弟兄西拉，简略地写了这封信劝勉你们，又向你们证实这是神真正的恩典；你们要在这恩典上站立得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我借着我认为忠心的弟兄西拉，简略地写了这封信劝勉你们，又向你们证实这是神真正的恩典；你们要在这恩典上站立得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 我略略地写了这信，托我所看为忠心的兄弟西拉转交你们，劝勉你们，又证明这恩是神的真恩。你们务要在这恩上站立得住。
verses.textEnNiv: With the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.
verses.textEnEsv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother as I regard him, I have written briefly to you, exhorting and declaring that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: By Silvanus, our faithful brother as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
verses.textEnNlt: I have written and sent this short letter to you with the help of Silas, whom I commend to you as a faithful brother. My purpose in writing is to encourage you and assure you that what you are experiencing is truly part of God’s grace for you. Stand firm in this grace.
verses.textEnNasb: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother (for so I regard him), I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it!
verses.textEn: With the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.

verses.textZh: 在巴比伦与你们同蒙拣选的，和我儿子马可都问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在巴比伦与你们同蒙拣选的，和我儿子马可都问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在巴比伦与你们同蒙拣选的教会问你们安。我儿子马可也问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.
verses.textEnEsv: She who is at Babylon, who is likewise chosen, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, my son.
verses.textEnNkjv: She who is in Babylon, elect together with you, greets you; and sodoes Mark my son.
verses.textEnNlt: Your sister church here in Babylon sends you greetings, and so does my son Mark.
verses.textEnNasb: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, and so does my son, Mark.
verses.textEn: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.

verses.textZh: 你们要用爱心彼此亲吻问安。愿平安归与你们所有在基督里的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用爱心彼此亲吻问安。愿平安归与你们所有在基督里的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要用爱心彼此亲嘴问安。愿平安归与你们凡在基督里的人！
verses.textEnNiv: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet one another with the kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet each other with a kiss of love. Peace be with all of you who are in Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ.
verses.textEn: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
